_comment: Crop viability rules for AgriCloud-CI. Edit this file to tune the advisory.
Each value has an 'optimal' band and a wider 'marginal' band; the marginal
band must contain the optimal band. Temperature is in °C, humidity and soil
Advice strings accept {crop} and {value} placeholders. A crop without its own
'advice' block inherits the shared defaults below, which keeps the file short
while still allowing a crop-specific sentence when needed.
The numbers below are typical agronomic values for Indian conditions and
must be checked against a local agronomy reference before the review.

advice.temperature_low: Temperature is low for {crop} (measured {value} °C); growth slows below the optimal band.
advice.temperature_high: Temperature is high for {crop} (measured {value} °C); heat stress is likely above the optimal band, so irrigate early in the morning and mulch.
advice.humidity_low: Humidity is low for {crop} (measured {value} %); dry air raises transpiration, so check soil moisture daily.
advice.humidity_high: Humidity is high for {crop} (measured {value} %); damp foliage raises disease risk, so improve airflow and scout the field.
advice.soil_moisture_low: Soil moisture is low for {crop} (measured {value} %); irrigate within 24 hours.
advice.soil_moisture_high: Soil moisture is high for {crop} (measured {value} %); pause irrigation and check field drainage.

advice.temperature_low: Temperature is low for Wheat (measured {value} °C); germination and tillering slow down below 12 °C.
advice.temperature_high: Temperature is high for Wheat (measured {value} °C); heat above 30 °C shortens grain filling, so irrigate early in the morning and mulch.
advice.humidity_low: Humidity is low for Wheat (measured {value} %); dry air raises transpiration, so check soil moisture daily.
advice.humidity_high: Humidity is high for Wheat (measured {value} %); prolonged damp air favours rust and powdery mildew, so inspect the leaves.
advice.soil_moisture_low: Soil moisture is low for Wheat (measured {value} %); irrigate within 24 hours.
advice.soil_moisture_high: Soil moisture is high for Wheat (measured {value} %); skip the next irrigation and check field drainage.

advice.temperature_low: Temperature is low for Cotton (measured {value} °C); boll development stalls below 18 °C.
advice.temperature_high: Temperature is high for Cotton (measured {value} °C); above 38 °C squares and bolls drop, so irrigate to cool the canopy.
advice.humidity_low: Humidity is low for Cotton (measured {value} %); dry air increases the risk of boll shedding.
advice.humidity_high: Humidity is high for Cotton (measured {value} %); a humid canopy raises boll rot risk, so improve airflow between rows.
advice.soil_moisture_low: Soil moisture is low for Cotton (measured {value} %); irrigate within 24 hours to protect flowering.
advice.soil_moisture_high: Soil moisture is high for Cotton (measured {value} %); waterlogged roots stall growth, so stop irrigation and improve drainage.

advice.temperature_low: Temperature is low for Soybeans (measured {value} °C); nodulation and growth slow below 15 °C.
advice.temperature_high: Temperature is high for Soybeans (measured {value} °C); pod set fails above 35 °C, so irrigate in the evening.
advice.humidity_low: Humidity is low for Soybeans (measured {value} %); dry air during flowering can abort pods.
advice.humidity_high: Humidity is high for Soybeans (measured {value} %); damp foliage favours frog-eye leaf spot, so scout the field.
advice.soil_moisture_low: Soil moisture is low for Soybeans (measured {value} %); irrigate within 24 hours because flowering is moisture critical.
advice.soil_moisture_high: Soil moisture is high for Soybeans (measured {value} %); saturated soil causes root rot, so pause irrigation.
